help_disclaimer: ⚠️ Ɲininkali jaabi in kɛra masini ye. I kɛnɛya kama, dɔgɔtɔrɔ ɲini.
map_tts_intro: I ni cɛ, aw bisimila karti nyɛ kan. Yan, i bɛ se ka dɛmɛ yɔrɔw ɲini i gɛrɛfɛ, ani ne bɛ se k'i ɲɛminɛ ka taa yen ni GPS ye.
